'''2020 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship on GEMP. [[Hayes Hunter]] finished 1st in the Final Four.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-match-play-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' April 2020
